pages.en:
F. 21
Arms Identification Section.
28th. October 1931.
File No. ........................

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

Sir,
With reference to the attached, the first estimate shows a complete list of assorted ammunition to provide ample supply of each type and allowing a surplus to cover unexpected requirements without interfering with the routine.

There is a large variety of each calibre of ammunition which show different effects when fired, so that it facilitates identification work to use corresponding rounds for testing, although it is not essential.

In testing licensed arms it is practice to take two tests with two kinds of ammunition.

For these reasons additional rounds of 8m/m, 9m/m, .25 and .32 calibres were listed. If the surplus had proved excessive, it could have been used the following year.

The revised list was made with a view to strict economy and based upon a calculated estimate of arms expected to be tested during the year.

Instead of allowing 3,000 rounds of .25 auto in four types, providing sufficient of each to cover excessive tests of one kind, this was reduced to 1,000 assorted rounds for even distribution.

The 2,000 rounds of .32 S.F.M. were cancelled as there is enough of this calibre in stock, but the stock is mostly of one kind, plain Pieper ammunition.

The revised list will provide sufficient for 1932 without altering the system if the arms maintain the average quoted, which is taken from past figures plus a slight allowance for increase and the testing of all licensed arms.

If any part of the stock proves insufficient, single tests could be resorted to as a temporary measure and in certain cases impressions could be taken without firing the weapons. This would be more difficult but could always be done if necessary and would not effect the results.

In the opinion of the undersigned the revised estimate should cover the requirements of 1932 without emergency measures, and there is no danger of efficiency being impaired.

M. E. Barnes
D.S.I.

P.A. (Crime).
pages.zh:
F. 21
枪械识别科。
1931年10月28日。
档案号 ........................

（刑事侦缉处）办公室笔记

先生，
关于所附文件，第一份预算列出了各类弹药的完整清单，以确保每种类型都有充足供应，并留有盈余以应对意外需求，而不干扰日常工作。

每种口径的弹药种类繁多，射击时表现出不同的效果，因此使用相应的子弹进行测试有助于识别工作，尽管这并非绝对必要。

在测试持照枪械时，惯例是使用两种弹药进行两次测试。

出于这些原因，清单中列出了额外的8毫米、9毫米、.25和.32口径子弹。如果证明盈余过多，可以在下一年使用。

修订后的清单旨在严格节约，并根据预计年内需测试的枪械数量进行估算。

原本允许提供4种类型的.25自动手枪弹共3,000发，以确保对某一种类的过度测试也有足够覆盖，现将其减少为1,000发混合弹药，以便均匀分配。

取消了2,000发.32 S.F.M.子弹，因为该口径库存充足，但库存大多为单一类型，即普通的皮珀（Pieper）弹药。

如果枪械数量保持在引用的平均水平（该水平取自过去的数据，并略微增加了增量以及所有持照枪械的测试量），修订后的清单将为1932年提供足够的弹药，且无需改变现有制度。

如果任何部分的库存证明不足，可以作为临时措施采取单次测试，在某些情况下，可以在不发射武器的情况下提取印痕。这样做会更困难，但在必要时总是可以完成，且不会影响结果。

具名人认为，修订后的预算应能涵盖1932年的需求，无需采取紧急措施，且不存在效率受损的风险。

M. E. 巴恩斯（M. E. Barnes）
副督察长

助理局长（罪案组）。

pages.en:
S. M. P. Armoury.
October 24, 1931.

Ammunition Estimates 1932
(Arms Identification Section)

D. C. Crime.

Sir,

Reference the attached Estimates for ammunition
for the A.I.S.

No. 1 Was handed in on the 13, October and it will be
seen that the amount asked for amounted in all
to 16,500 Rounds; which amount added to their
present Stock of 15,199 Rounds (No. 3) struck
me as being in excess of possible requirements.
S.I. Bonner was asked to show how this Ammunition
was to be expended and cut his estimate down
to the lowest minimum.

No. 2 Was received on the 23rd and it will be seen
that there is a cut of 11,800 Rds.

| No. 1 Estimate | No. 2 Estimate | Remarks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Various Cal: ) Auto:Pistol ) 6,300 Rds: | 1,100 Rds | = Less 5,200 Rds |
| Various Cal: ) Revolver ) 2,200 Rds: | 350 Rds | = Less 1,850 Rds |
| S.M.P. Various 8,000 Rds: | 3,250 Rds | = Less 4,750 Rds |
| Total | | 11,800 Rds |

Although No. 2 is quite clear and shows the amount
required, I would like, in face of the very big reduction
of over 11,000 Rds:, to have your approval for the Estimate
to go forward.

W Staubern
Musketry Officer.

上海公共租界工部局警务处军械库。
1931年10月24日。

1932年弹药预算
（枪械识别科）

致 罪案组副总监。

先生，

参照所附枪械识别科（A.I.S.）的
弹药预算。

第1号预算于10月13日提交，可以看出
申请的总量共计
16,500发；加上他们
现有的15,199发库存（第3号），
我觉得这超出了可能的需求。
已要求副督察长邦纳说明这些弹药
将如何消耗，并将其预算削减
至最低限度。

第2号预算于23日收到，可以看出
减少了11,800发。

| 第1号预算 | 第2号预算 | 备注 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 各种口径：) 自动手枪 ) 6,300发： | 1,100发 | = 减少5,200发 |
| 各种口径：) 左轮手枪 ) 2,200发： | 350发 | = 减少1,850发 |
| 上海公共租界工部局警务处 各种 8,000发： | 3,250发 | = 减少4,750发 |
| 总计 | | 11,800发 |

虽然第2号预算非常清晰并显示了所需数量，但鉴于超过11,000发的巨大削减，我希望得到您的批准，以便将该预算向前推进。

W·斯塔伯恩（W Staubern）
射击教官/军械官。
